components.name: CareAgents
components.description: A patient's health assistant that answers a clinic's check-in request from their records, with per-item consent. Answers are encrypted in the browser and not stored by CareAgents.
components.notes: Sign in on the wallet page with an emailed code, then pick the synthetic test patient when the wallet offers it (self-serve, no real data). Supports the three minimum scenarios: share records and insurance (US Core, C4DIC Coverage), PHQ-2 inline, decline an item. Also answers short forms inline (up to 30 questions); optional questions it cannot answer are shown to the patient as not sent, and a required one it cannot answer means the whole form is not answered. Records are checked against US Core before they are sent, and any that fail are held back. Responses are capped at about 400 KB, so the large-response scenario is not supported yet. Testing guide: https://healthclaw.io/static/connectathon/careagents-wallet.html
